text.description_html:
McKinney 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Raised Barrel Heavy Weight Stainless Steel Hinge with Ball Bearings

Special type Raised Barrel Hinge: The hinge pin and knuckle are moved away from the door frame via its bent hinge leaves. Recommended for use on high frequency and/or heavy wood or metal doors where the door is set in a deep revealed frame.

Heavy weight raised barrel hinges are supplied with a no hole bottom plug and the pin is held in place by an NRP set screw which allows the hinge to be reversible. For doors that are not beveled on hinge side.

Fitted with a high grade rust resistant, stainless steel pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications of the McKinney 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Raised Barrel Stainless Steel Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.180" (Heavy Duty)
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Hinge Type: Raised Barrel

* These hinges are normally special order 5-6 weeks to ship.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
